C0416.title: Microsoft 365 MFA Bypass Incident
C0416.summary: An attacker successfully logged into a corporate Microsoft 365 account using only single-factor authentication, despite security defaults being enabled. The user had set up the Microsoft Authenticator app for MFA, but sign-in logs showed the attacker bypassed multi-factor authentication. This case discusses common MFA bypass methods such as MFA fatigue attacks, token theft, and adversary-in-the-mi
